v0.10 construction qualification

Static/package checks performed by assistant:
- Python sources compile with py_compile.
- shell scripts pass sh -n.
- native source contains create_guarded export and prior build path unchanged.
- archive integrity checked after creation.

Runtime qualification required on the target Android/Termux ooRexx build:
  ./build.sh
  python python/guarded_start_demo.py
  ./run-tests.sh

The assistant environment does not contain the target Android ooRexx runtime, so the START/GUARD behavior is deliberately marked as an experiment until the target run passes.
